recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future changes to distinguish AOEs, order questions, and existing supporting context should proceed through a new OO decision rather than reopening this already-satisfied datatype request.
issue_request: FHIR-25552 was an Applied, Persuasive OO issue raised against R4 to add CodeableReference to ServiceRequest.supportingInfo for coded, referenced, or textual supporting information such as HL7 v2 OBR-13 context; its final resolution says the capability is in R5 and R4 users should use pre-adoption.
initial_application: No separate FHIR-25552-tagged source-changing commit was found. The requested R5 source state was already achieved by FHIR-37355 commit e9c8a9961a7614db9d4326afb6000fadb72653e1 in PR 2589 before FHIR-25552 was resolved as applied.
additional_context: FHIR-25554 asked for the broader Request.supportingInfo datatype change and was closed Resolved - No Change, so the final outcome is ServiceRequest-specific. FHIR-25553 separately clarified note versus supportingInfo, and FHIR-31589 later clarified supportingInfo versus orderDetail without reversing the datatype.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because ServiceRequest is active in fhir.ini and the current build-scope StructureDefinition already defines ServiceRequest.supportingInfo as CodeableReference(Resource).
